final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaingb, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) as avg_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as overall_mean FROM group_stats WHERE avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL), final_stats AS (SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.insurstat, gs.avg_remaingb, gs.avg_cpu_gpu_diff, CASE WHEN mc.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL THEN gs.avg_remaingb / mc.overall_mean ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remaingb, avg_cpu_gpu_diff, ratio FROM final_stats ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
